svg.title: CoCo Zero I/O page map
svg.desc: PIZERO-279: where each sound device sits in $FF00-$FFFF, and which work beside Disk BASIC without a Multi-Pak slot switch. Hover an address or a device; click a device to take it out of the machine.
svg.text: Where each sound device sits, and which can live beside Disk BASIC without a Multi-Pak slot switch. Hover an address or a device; click a device to take it out.
